title: Duckling eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="30" ry="22" fill="#FFD83D"/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="26" ry="16" fill="#F5C400"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="38" r="20" fill="#FFE45C"/>
  <!-- head shading -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="42" r="16" fill="#FFD83D"/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="34" r="4" fill="#4A3B10"/>
  <circle cx="34.5" cy="32.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFFDF0"/>
  <!-- beak upper -->
  <path d="M 22 42 Q 10 44 12 50 Q 14 54 24 50 Z" fill="#FF8C32"/>
  <!-- beak lower -->
  <path d="M 22 50 Q 14 52 16 56 Q 18 58 24 54 Z" fill="#E86E1A"/>
  <!-- bread/snack in beak -->
  <path d="M 12 46 Q 4 44 2 50 Q 1 56 8 56 Q 14 56 16 52 Z" fill="#C68B45"/>
  <path d="M 12 46 Q 4 44 2 50 Q 1 56 8 56 Q 14 56 16 52 Z" fill="none" stroke="#9A6528" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- bread crust top -->
  <path d="M 12 46 Q 4 44 2 50 Q 6 48 12 48 Z" fill="#8B5A22"/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="60" rx="14" ry="10" fill="#F5C400"/>
  <!-- wing detail -->
  <path d="M 54 56 Q 62 52 70 56" fill="none" stroke="#E8B800" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d="M 38 86 L 32 92 L 44 92 Z" fill="#FF8C32"/>
  <path d="M 58 86 L 52 92 L 64 92 Z" fill="#FF8C32"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M 78 58 Q 88 52 86 62 Q 84 68 76 66 Z" fill="#FFE45C"/>
  <!-- little crumbs -->
  <circle cx="8" cy="58" r="1.5" fill="#C68B45"/>
  <circle cx="5" cy="53" r="1" fill="#C68B45"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="60" r="1.2" fill="#C68B45"/>
</svg>
